content.text:
Siemens to deliver Romania’s First Hydrogen-Powered Train Fleet: Siemens said ARF awarded it a contract for 12 two-car Mireo Plus H units, including full maintenance and repair for an initial 15-year term, with passenger service due in 2029. This release establishes that the Romanian train award and 2029 target predated Ballard’s October module-order announcement; it does not identify Ballard’s module order. (time=2026-04-28; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
200 kW fuel cell modules to power 12 hydrogen passenger trains - Interesting Engineering: The captured excerpt describes the Romanian 12-train fleet and Ballard’s 24-module order, and quotes Siemens and Ballard executives on the expansion of their relationship and prior German deployments. It is coverage of the issuer announcement, not separate confirmation of the purchase order. (time=2026-10-09T14:13:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Ballard Wins 4.8 MW Siemens Order to Power Romania’s Hydrogen Trains: The currently accessible page displays this byline and October 7 date and recaps the order. No dated pre-cutoff snapshot or revision history was verified, so its article text is not used as cutoff-verified corroboration. (time=2026-10-07; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

content.text:
Ballard Secures 4.8MW Order from Siemens Mobility to Power Hydrogen Trains in Romania: Ballard announced an order from Siemens Mobility for 24 FCrail 200 kW modules (4.8 MW) intended for 12 Mireo Plus H trains for Romania’s ARF. It scheduled module deliveries for 2027–2028 and passenger service for 2029. The release labels these schedules forward-looking and notes risks including third-party reliance and manufacturing capacity. SEC Exhibit 99.1 reproduces the release dated October 6. (time=2026-10-06 22:30 ET; cutoff=UNKNOWN).
Siemens to deliver Romania’s First Hydrogen-Powered Train Fleet: Siemens said ARF awarded it a contract for 12 two-car Mireo Plus H units, including full maintenance and repair for an initial 15-year term, with passenger service due in 2029. This release establishes that the Romanian train award and 2029 target predated Ballard’s October module-order announcement; it does not identify Ballard’s module order. (time=2026-04-28; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
România vrea să cumpere 12 trenuri pe hidrogen. Există, însă, obstacole: infrastructura și stațiile de alimentare: The currently accessible page, labeled April 19, reports concerns about rail infrastructure, hydrogen refuelling stations, and funding before the April 28 Siemens contract announcement. Without a dated pre-cutoff snapshot or revision history, it does not establish that those concerns remained unresolved at the cutoff. (time=2026-04-19 19:34 (timezone not stated); cutoff=UNKNOWN).
